quotes.text: Gurbani is the process of you losing yourself, losing your fears and becoming fearless.
quotes.source: personal

quotes.text: I've lost that sense of fear and now action is flowing out of me from my sense of compassion. Walking by this wisdom which is leading me.
quotes.source: personal

quotes.text: I have no fear of what the consequences is so what. I've already given myself up. I'm already dead. Action is a natural outcome of losing the ego.
quotes.source: personal

quotes.text: Dharam di Kirat karni — Earn by honest means.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (1)

quotes.text: Daswand dena — Give one tenth of your salary.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (2)

quotes.text: Gurbani kantth karni — Memorize Gurbani.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (3)

quotes.text: Amrit Vaelae utthna — Wake up Amrit Vela (before dawn).
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (4)

quotes.text: Sikh sewak di sewa ruchi naal karni — Serve a Sikh Servant with devotion.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (5)

quotes.text: Gurbani dae arth Sikh vidhvana tuo parrhnae — Learn the meanings of Gurbani from Sikh Scholars.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (6)

quotes.text: Punj Kakaar di Rehat drirh kar rukhni — Follow the discipline of the 5 K's strictly.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (7)

quotes.text: Shabad da abhihas karna — Practice Shabad Gurbani in life.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (8)

quotes.text: Sat-Saroop Satgur da dhian dharna — Concentrate on the True Guru (God).
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (9)

quotes.text: Guru Granth Sahib Ji noo Guru mananaa — Accept Guru Granth Sahib Ji as Guru.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (10)

quotes.text: Kaarjaan dae arambh vich ardaas karni — At the beginning of a task, perform ardaas
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (11)

quotes.text: Jaman, maran, ja viah mokae Jup da paatth kar tihaaval (Karaah Parsaad) kar anand sahib dia punj paurian, ardaas, pratham punj pyaariaan atae hazoori granthi noo vartaa kae oprunth sangat noo vartaaouna — At birth, death, or marriage ceremonies, do Japji Sahib, make Karaah Parshaad, do five stanzas of anand sahib, do ardaas, and then distribute Karaah Parshaad to the Panj Pyare, the Granthi, and then to the sangat.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (12)

quotes.text: Jab tak Karaah Parshaad vartadaa rahae sadh sangat addol batthee rahae — Until Karaah Parshaad is completely distributed, the Sangat should remain sitting and unmoving.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (13)

quotes.text: Anand Viah bina grahist nahi karna — Do not start married life without Anand Karaj (Sikh
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (14)

quotes.text: Par-Istri, Ma-Bhain, Dhi-Bhain, kar jaanani. Par Istri da sang nahi karna — Recognize all other women other than your wife as mothers and sisters. Do not engage in marital behaviour with them.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (15)

quotes.text: Istri da mooh nahi fitkaarnaa — Do not silence your wife?
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (16)

quotes.text: Jagat-jootth tambaaku bikhiaa da tiaag karna — Abandon worldly falsehoods and tobacco-poison.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (17)

quotes.text: Rehatvaan atae naam jupan vaalae gursikhaa di sangat karni — Keep the company of Sikhs who follow the Rehat and meditate on the Name (of God).
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (18)

quotes.text: Kum karan vich daridar nahi karna — Don't be lazy while doing work.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (19)

quotes.text: Gurbani di katha tae keertan roaz sunanaa atae karna — Listen and do kirtan and Gurbani discourses daily.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (20)

quotes.text: Kisae di ninda, chugali, atae eirkha nahi karni — Do not engage in slander, gossip or spite anyone
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (21)

quotes.text: Dhan, jawaani, tae kul-jaat da abhiman nahi karnaa (Nanak daadak tahe duae goath. Saak guru sikhan sang hoath) — Do not take pride in wealth, youth and caste. (Mother and Father's caste both castes. All Sikhs of the Guru are siblings)?
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (22)

quotes.text: Mat uchi tae suchi rakhni — Keep the religious discipline high and pure.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (23)

quotes.text: Shubh karman tao kadae naa ttarnaa — Do not refrain from doing Righteous deeds.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (24)

quotes.text: Budh bal da daataa vaheguroo noo jaananaa — Recognize God as the giver of intellect and strength.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (25)

quotes.text: Sugandh (kasam sahu) dae kar itbaar janaaoun vaalae tae yakeen nahi karna — Do not believe a person who swears (one who tries/attempts to convince someone with a 'saun or saugandh').
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (26)

quotes.text: Sutantar Vicharna. Raaj Kaaj dian kamaan tae doosrae mutaa dia purshaan noo huk nahi daenaa — Rule Independently. In the affairs of government, do not give people of other religions authority or power.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (27)

quotes.text: Raajniti parhni — Study politics.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (28)

quotes.text: Dushman naal saam, daam, bhaed, aadiak, upaa vartnae — With the enemy, practice/deploy the various techniques/tactics of diplomacy (saam, daam, dand, bhed).
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (29)

quotes.text: Shaster vidyaa atae ghorhae di savaari da abhiaas karna — Practice the knowledge of weaponry and horse riding.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (30)

quotes.text: Doosrae mataa dae pustak, vidyaa parhni. Pur bhrosaa drirh Gurbani, Akal Purakh tae karnaa — Study the books and knowledge of other faiths. But keep trust in Gurbani and Akal Purukh.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (31)

quotes.text: Gurupdaesaa noo dhaaran karna — Follow the teachings of the Guru.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (32)

quotes.text: Raheraas da paath kar kharae ho kae ardaas karni — After Rehras Paatth, do Ardaas standing up.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (33)

quotes.text: Saun valae sohila atae 'paun guru pani pita...' salok parhna — Recite Sohila and 'paun guru pani pita...' stanza before going to sleep.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (34)

quotes.text: Dastaar bina nahi rehnaa — Wear a turban at all times.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (35)

quotes.text: Singha da adha naam nahi bulauna — Do not call a Singh by half of their name (nickname).
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (36)

quotes.text: Sharaab nai saevani — Do not partake of alcoholic drinks.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (37)

quotes.text: Sir munae noo kanaiaa nahi daeni. Uos ghar daevni jithae Akal Purukh di sikhi ha, jo karzaai naa hovae, bhalae subhaa da hovae, bibaeki atae gyanvaan hovae — Do not give a daughter's hand to a clean shaven. Give her hand in a house where God's Sikhi exists, where the household is not in debt, is of a good nature, is disciplined and knowledgeable.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (38)

quotes.text: Subh kaaraj Gurbani anusaar karnae — Do all work in accordance with Gurbani.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (39)

quotes.text: Chugali kar kisae da kam nahi vigaarnaa — Do not ruin someone's work by gossip.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (40)

quotes.text: Kaurha bachan nahi kahinaa — Do not utter bitter statements.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (41)

quotes.text: Darshan yaatraa gurdwaaraa di hi karni — Make pilgrimages to Gurdwaras only.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (42)

quotes.text: Bachan karkae paalnaa — Fulfill all of the promises that you make
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (43)

quotes.text: Pardaesi, lorvaan, dukhi, apung manukh di yataahshkat sewa karni — Do as much sewa as you can for foreigners, the needy and the troubled.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (44)

quotes.text: Putari da dhan bikh jananaa — Recognize the property of a daughter as poison? - See your daughter's wealth and earnings as poison (do not consume them)
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (45)

quotes.text: Dikhaawae da Sikh nahi bananaa — Do not become an outward show-off Sikh.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (46)

quotes.text: Sikhi kesaa-suaasa sang nibhaaouni — Live and die a Keshadhaari Sikh
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (47)

quotes.text: Chori, yaari, tthugi, dhokaa, dagaa bahi karnaa — Refrain from engaging in theft, adultery / promiscuity / permissiveness , fraud, deceit, embezzlement.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (48)

quotes.text: Sikh da itbaar karna — Believe a Sikh.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (49)

quotes.text: Jhutthi gavaahi nahi daeni — Do not give false testimony.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (50)

quotes.text: Dhroh nahi karnaa — Do not cheat.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (51)

quotes.text: Langar-Parshaad ik ras vartaaunaa — Distribute Langar and Karaah Parshaad with equality.
quotes.source: 52 Hukams of Guru Gobind Singh Ji (52)

quotes.text: Live is lived on the margin. The call goes out each and every day.
quotes.source: abide in the one, act now

quotes.text:
God steers but you must row.
— e.g. how I got my job, which led to bitcoin, which led to Sikhi
— e.g. how I got my wife
— e.g. the progression of the Sikh gurus
quotes.source: personal

quotes.text:
God loves a good irony.
— e.g. the state of Punjab currently
quotes.source: personal

quotes.text:
Enjoy but don't attach
Give but don't expect
Listen but don't judge
Love but don't depend
Accept but don't settle
quotes.source: personal

quotes.text: All is one - there is no duality
quotes.source: personal

quotes.text: Look upon friend and foe alike
quotes.source: personal

quotes.text: It’s all according the will of the Doer. We are powerless it’s all in your hands. This precious life can be over in an instant.
quotes.source: personal

quotes.text: you step on an ant, you kill a fly. What makes it right, what makes it wrong.
quotes.source: personal

quotes.text: there is only oneness. Yet the irony is that we live in duality. This duality is called Maya. You live with the oneness in mind yet surrounded by the chaos of duality. How to traverse this ocean of Maya. It’s all in your hands. The Khalsa lives in duality that’s why it’s emphasized both the Miri and Piri.
quotes.source: personal
